import matplotlib
matplotlib.use('Agg')
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import matplotlib.patches as mpatches
import numpy as np
from matplotlib.lines import Line2D
from matplotlib.patheffects import withStroke

# ── Data ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
years = [1970, 1980, 1990, 2000, 2010, 2025]
x_positions = list(range(len(years)))

data = [
    {"country": "United States",   "ranks": [1,  1,  1,  1,  1,  1]},
    {"country": "Japan",           "ranks": [3,  2,  2,  2,  3,  4]},
    {"country": "Germany",         "ranks": [2,  3,  3,  3,  4,  3]},
    {"country": "France",          "ranks": [4,  4,  4,  5,  5,  7]},
    {"country": "United Kingdom",  "ranks": [5,  5,  6,  4,  6,  6]},
    {"country": "Italy",           "ranks": [6,  6,  5,  6,  7,  9]},
    {"country": "Canada",          "ranks": [7,  7,  7,  7,  9, 10]},
    {"country": "China",           "ranks": [9, 10, 10,  6,  2,  2]},
    {"country": "Brazil",          "ranks": [8,  8,  9,  9,  8,  8]},
    {"country": "India",           "ranks": [13, 13, 13, 12, 10,  5]},
    {"country": "Australia",       "ranks": [10, 11, 11, 11, 13, 13]},
    {"country": "South Korea",     "ranks": [15, 15, 15, 13, 14, 12]},
    {"country": "Mexico",          "ranks": [12, 12, 12, 10, 11, 14]},
    {"country": "Spain",           "ranks": [11,  9,  8,  8, 12, 15]},
    {"country": "Russia",          "ranks": [14, 14, 14, 14, 15, 11]},
]

# ── Style config ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
HIGHLIGHT = {
    "China":  {"color": "#E63946", "lw": 4.0, "zorder": 10, "alpha": 1.0},
    "Japan":  {"color": "#F4A261", "lw": 3.2, "zorder": 9,  "alpha": 1.0},
    "India":  {"color": "#2EC4B6", "lw": 3.2, "zorder": 8,  "alpha": 1.0},
    "United States": {"color": "#4361EE", "lw": 2.5, "zorder": 7, "alpha": 1.0},
}
DEFAULT_STYLE = {"color": "#C8C8D8", "lw": 1.4, "zorder": 2, "alpha": 0.75}

BG_COLOR     = "#0F1117"
PANEL_COLOR  = "#161B27"
TEXT_COLOR   = "#E8E8F0"
SUBTITLE_CLR = "#9090B0"
GRID_COLOR   = "#2A2A3E"
ANNO_COLOR   = "#F0F0FF"

# ── Figure ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
fig = plt.figure(figsize=(16, 11), facecolor=BG_COLOR)
ax  = fig.add_axes([0.10, 0.09, 0.72, 0.78], facecolor=PANEL_COLOR)

# vertical grid lines at each year column
for xi in x_positions:
    ax.axvline(xi, color=GRID_COLOR, linewidth=0.8, zorder=1)

# horizontal grid lines at each rank
for rank in range(1, 16):
    ax.axhline(rank, color=GRID_COLOR, linewidth=0.4, linestyle='--', zorder=1)

# ── Smooth bump lines (cardinal-spline approximation via many points) ────────
def smooth_path(xs, ys, n=300):
    """Linear interp — good enough for a bump chart."""
    t  = np.linspace(0, len(xs) - 1, n)
    xi = np.interp(t, range(len(xs)), xs)
    yi = np.interp(t, range(len(xs)), ys)
    return xi, yi

for entry in data:
    country = entry["country"]
    ranks   = entry["ranks"]
    style   = HIGHLIGHT.get(country, DEFAULT_STYLE)

    xs_s, ys_s = smooth_path(x_positions, ranks)

    # shadow / glow for highlights
    if country in HIGHLIGHT:
        ax.plot(xs_s, ys_s,
                color=style["color"], linewidth=style["lw"] + 3,
                alpha=0.18, zorder=style["zorder"] - 1)

    ax.plot(xs_s, ys_s,
            color=style["color"],
            linewidth=style["lw"],
            alpha=style["alpha"],
            solid_capstyle='round',
            zorder=style["zorder"])

    # dots at each year
    dot_size = 60 if country in HIGHLIGHT else 20
    ax.scatter(x_positions, ranks,
               color=style["color"],
               s=dot_size,
               zorder=style["zorder"] + 1,
               edgecolors='none')

# ── Right-side labels ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
right_labels = {}
for entry in data:
    rank_2025 = entry["ranks"][-1]
    right_labels[rank_2025] = entry["country"]

for rank, country in right_labels.items():
    style = HIGHLIGHT.get(country, DEFAULT_STYLE)
    color = style["color"]
    weight = 'bold' if country in HIGHLIGHT else 'normal'
    fontsize = 9.5 if country in HIGHLIGHT else 8.2
    ax.text(len(years) - 1 + 0.12, rank, country,
            va='center', ha='left',
            color=color, fontsize=fontsize, fontweight=weight,
            zorder=15)

# ── Left-side rank labels ────────────────────────────────────────────────────
for entry in data:
    rank_1970 = entry["ranks"][0]
    country   = entry["country"]
    style     = HIGHLIGHT.get(country, DEFAULT_STYLE)
    color     = style["color"]
    weight    = 'bold' if country in HIGHLIGHT else 'normal'
    fontsize  = 9.5 if country in HIGHLIGHT else 8.2
    ax.text(-0.12, rank_1970, country,
            va='center', ha='right',
            color=color, fontsize=fontsize, fontweight=weight,
            zorder=15)

# ── Axes formatting ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
ax.set_xlim(-0.15, len(years) - 1 + 0.15)
ax.set_ylim(15.6, 0.4)   # rank 1 at top
ax.set_xticks(x_positions)
ax.set_xticklabels([str(y) for y in years], color=TEXT_COLOR, fontsize=12, fontweight='bold')
ax.set_yticks(range(1, 16))
ax.set_yticklabels([f"#{r}" for r in range(1, 16)], color=SUBTITLE_CLR, fontsize=8.5)
